purpose: Fix what a person sees and can do the moment it opens, and prove a page actually renders inside its sandbox.

questions.question: What can they do on it? List every button, field and list, one per line starting with a dash.
If they change something, does it need to still be there next time? The page cannot save anything by itself.
Any pictures, icons or fonts? They get embedded into the file, so keep them small.
Anything that should move or refresh on its own?
Any colour outside the app's own set, such as a chart palette?

artifact: the Frontend row of APP.md; check.py writes the Checks cell and appends render: dark+light or render: not run to Owner notes

rules.rule: index.html is a body fragment, not a document. The server prepends charset, colour-scheme, the token sheet and the theme script, then the file verbatim.
Every control is a real button, a[href], input, select or textarea in reading order, with an accessible name, reachable by Tab, with a visible focus ring. No click handler on a div.

The page cannot remember anything. On the opaque origin localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB and document.cookie throw; responses are no-store; the frame reloads on theme switch. Durable state lives in the file.
rules.sutra_source: static/js/18-modules.js sandbox and frame nonce; modules_api.py Cache-Control no-store; 2026-09-08-modules-design.md
rules.enforced_by: C35; C37 forces the answer to be one of the two honest options

rules.rule: Fit the pane, not a monitor: roughly 260px of usable width at the worst.
rules.sutra_source: static/panel.css pane widths; modules_api.py body padding

rules.rule: A page ships only when it has been rendered in both themes with no console errors. When no headless runtime is available the record says render: not run and the run is incomplete, never a pass.
A link's whole surface is its row: name, tagline, and the Open control that appears only when the screen resolves. The Frontend row of a link's record reads n-a (link).
rules.enforced_by: C3 and C32; no separate link branch of C36

rules.rule: A chat has nothing to render. Its surface is one string, and every chat verdict in this kit is a static read of that string.
rules.enforced_by: C36 reports n/a for chat and the runner prints that line

checks.what: index.html is a body fragment with one root element carrying lang, inline style and script only.
checks.evaluator: HTMLParser census FAILs on a doctype, <html, <head, <body, <frameset, any <script src=, any <link tag; FAILs when no element carries lang=; WARNs on more than one top-level element

checks.what: Every control is a real control with an accessible name.
checks.evaluator: FAIL on onclick/onkeydown on a div or span, role=button without tabindex, img without alt, tabindex above 0, outline:none with no :focus-visible rule; accessible name resolved from text, aria-label, title, aria-labelledby; unresolvable statically is WARN; render clause advisory

checks.what: The page does not try to store anything.
checks.evaluator: FAIL on localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, document.cookie, caches., navigator.storage, Notification, requestPermission; dynamic property access is not caught and the check text says so

checks.what: The page renders in both themes with a non-empty body and no console errors.
checks.evaluator: headless Chrome over raw CDP (the qa-shell/apps-check.mjs lane): navigate to /api/modules/<id>/page?theme=dark then light, assert zero exceptions, zero console errors, zero failed loads, body text non-empty; no runtime reachable reports skip, writes render: not run and exits 3 unless --allow-skip-render; chat and link read n/a

checks.what: The F2 answer is one of the two honest options.
checks.evaluator: the cell's first phrase, normalized, is 'resets each time' or 'baked into the file'; anything else FAILs with both options quoted
